# routeros_routing_rip_instance (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_routing_rip_instance" "instance" {
  name     = "example"
  afi      = "ip"
  disabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the RIP instance, referenced by the interface templates and the static neighbors.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `afi` (String) The address family this instance operates on.
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `in_filter_chain` (String) Name of the routing filter chain that is applied to the routes received by this instance.
- `originate_default` (String) Controls the origination of the default route into RIP.
- `out_filter_chain` (String) Name of the routing filter chain that is applied to the routes advertised by this instance.
- `out_filter_select` (String) Name of the `/routing/filter/select-rule` chain that decides which of the candidate routes are advertised by this instance.
- `redistribute` (Set of String) Enable the redistribution of the listed route types into RIP.
- `route_gc_timeout` (String) The garbage collection time. A route that has expired is kept in the table and advertised as unreachable for this long before it is removed.
- `route_timeout` (String) The time after which a route that has not been refreshed by an update is declared expired.
- `routing_table` (String) Name of the routing table the routes of this instance are installed into.
- `update_interval` (String) The interval between the periodic RIP updates.
- `vrf` (String) The VRF table this resource operates on.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
#The ID can be found via API or the terminal
#The command for the terminal is -> :put [/routing/rip/instance get [print show-ids]]
terraform import routeros_routing_rip_instance.instance "*1"
```
